---
title: "L04: Immunosuppressants"
description: "ATC L04 immunosuppressants: the level-2 group covering L04A, from calcineurin inhibitors to the interleukin and JAK inhibitors."
date: "2026-09-22"
---

L04 has a single level-3 subgroup, [L04A](l04a/), which carries the whole group: calcineurin inhibitors (ciclosporin, tacrolimus), TNF-α inhibitors, interleukin inhibitors, and the JAK inhibitors.
WHO gives L04 and L04A the same name.
